name: digimon-vpet-world-source
description: Functional open source unreal engine project of Digimon VPET World, an Unreal Engine source-based fan project inspired by classic Digimon virtual pets, modern Digimon games, built entirely in 3D anime-style cel-shaded graphics, with 3D Digimon & optional 2D animated Digimon sprites rendered inside a 3D world
